items.title: The Optimal Exercise Modality and Dose for Blood Pressure Management in Middle-Aged and Older Adults: A Systematic Review with Bayesian Model-Based, and Dose-Response Network Meta-Analysis of RCTs.
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of RCTs found that for middle-aged and older adults, combined aerobic and resistance training, with sufficient volume, was most effective for lowering systolic and diastolic blood pressure, outperforming other modalities.
items.curatedReason: 别再只推单一运动降压了，中老年人合并有氧和抗阻训练，且保证一定训练量（如每周 150 分钟中等强度），才是降低收缩压和舒张压的王道。
items.titleZh: 中老年人血压管理最佳运动模式与剂量：一项包含贝叶斯模型和剂量-反应网络荟萃分析的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项关于中老年人血压管理的系统综述和网络荟萃分析发现，结合有氧和抗阻训练，达到一定训练量时，降血压效果最佳，优于其他模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stop recommending single exercise modes for blood pressure reduction. For middle-aged and older adults, combined aerobic and resistance training with sufficient volume (e.g., 150 minutes/week moderate intensity) is the gold standard for lowering both systolic and diastolic blood pressure.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的 RCT 异质性较高，可能影响荟萃分析结果的精度。
items.limitationEn: The included RCTs exhibit high heterogeneity, potentially affecting the precision of the meta-analysis results.

items.title: Comparative effectiveness of exercise-based prehabilitation before total knee arthroplasty: a systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of RCTs comparing prehabilitation before total knee arthroplasty (TKA) found that multimodal exercise programs were more effective than single modalities, suggesting a comprehensive approach for better outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 全膝关节置换术 (TKA) 前的术前康复，别再纠结单项功能训练了，这项系统综述和网络荟萃分析提示，多模式联合方案（耐力、力量、平衡、功能训练）效果更佳。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术前运动基康复的比较有效性：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项比较全膝关节置换术前运动基康复的系统综述和网络荟萃分析发现，多模式运动方案比单一模式更有效，提示应采取综合性方法以获得更好的结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: For prehabilitation before total knee arthroplasty (TKA), move beyond single-modality training. This systematic review and network meta-analysis suggests that multimodal, combined programs (endurance, strength, balance, functional training) yield superior outcomes.
items.limitation: 纳入的研究在运动方案、持续时间和强度上存在异质性，限制了直接比较。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in exercise protocols, duration, and intensity across included studies limits direct comparisons.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of combined balance and plyometric training on athletic performance: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review found that combined balance and plyometric training significantly improves athletic performance, highlighting its effectiveness in enhancing explosive power, agility, and dynamic stability for athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述表明，结合平衡与增强式训练可以显著提高运动员的运动表现。这为 PT 提供了有力证据，支持在运动专项训练中纳入结合这两种训练模式的方案，以提升爆发力、敏捷性和稳定性。
items.titleZh: 结合平衡与增强式训练对运动表现的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述发现，结合平衡与增强式训练可显著提高运动表现，强调其在增强爆发力、敏捷性和动态稳定性方面的有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review demonstrates that combined balance and plyometric training significantly enhances athletic performance. This provides strong evidence for PTs to incorporate both training modalities into sport-specific programs to improve explosive power, agility, and stability.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的训练方案和评估方法存在异质性，可能影响结果的精确度。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in training protocols and assessment methods across included studies may affect the precision of the results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of different aerobic exercise intensities on exercise capacity, quality of life and mortality in individuals with coronary artery disease: systematic review and network meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis found that moderate-intensity aerobic exercise may be the most effective for improving exercise capacity, quality of life, and mortality in individuals with coronary artery disease (CAD).
items.curatedReason: 对于冠心病 (CAD) 患者，这项高质量系统综述提示，在改善运动能力、生活质量和降低死亡率方面，中等强度有氧运动效果最佳。制定心脏康复计划时，你现在可以更明确地推荐中等强度。
items.titleZh: 不同有氧运动强度对冠心病患者运动能力、生活质量和死亡率的影响：一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析发现，中等强度的有氧运动可能最有效地改善冠心病 (CAD) 患者的运动能力、生活质量和死亡率。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with coronary artery disease (CAD), this high-quality systematic review suggests moderate-intensity aerobic exercise is likely optimal for improving exercise capacity, quality of life, and mortality. When designing cardiac rehab, you now have strong evidence to prioritize moderate intensity.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的训练强度定义可能存在差异，对网络荟萃分析结果的精确性产生影响。
items.limitationEn: Variations in the definition of exercise intensity across included studies might impact the precision of the network meta-analysis results.

items.title: Effect of six weeks of ankle stretching exercises on ankle dorsiflexion range of motion and anterior knee pain in children with ankle pronation: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that six weeks of ankle stretching exercises significantly improved ankle dorsiflexion range of motion and reduced anterior knee pain in children with ankle pronation.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 研究表明，为期六周的踝关节牵伸训练可以显著改善儿童踝关节背屈活动度，并可能减轻前膝痛。这为 PT 提供了具体的干预手段，以解决与儿童踝关节过度内旋相关的膝痛问题。
items.titleZh: 六周踝关节牵伸运动对儿童踝关节过度内旋引起的踝关节背屈活动度和前膝痛的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，六周的踝关节牵伸运动可显著改善儿童踝关节过度内旋患者的踝关节背屈活动度，并减轻前膝痛。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that six weeks of ankle stretching exercises significantly improve ankle dorsiflexion range of motion and may reduce anterior knee pain in children with ankle pronation. This provides PTs with a specific intervention to address knee pain related to pediatric ankle overpronation.
items.limitation: 研究仅关注了六周的短期效果，长期效益和对其他步态参数的影响尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study focused only on short-term effects over six weeks; long-term benefits and effects on other gait parameters remain unclear.

items.title: Differences in the Thoracolumbar Fascia Between Low Back Pain Patients and Healthy Individuals: A Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analysis found differences in the thoracolumbar fascia (TLF) between low back pain patients and healthy individuals, suggesting the TLF plays a role in LBP and warrants further investigation into its pathophysiology and targeted interventions.
items.curatedReason: 腰痛患者的胸腰筋膜 (TLF) 确实与健康人不同，但这离说清楚 TLF 是腰痛主因还差得远。目前还需更多研究来阐明其具体病理生理机制和靶向干预方法。
items.titleZh: 腰痛患者与健康个体胸腰筋膜的差异：一项含荟萃分析的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项含荟萃分析的系统综述发现，腰痛患者与健康个体在胸腰筋膜 (TLF) 上存在差异，提示 TLF 在腰痛中起作用，并需要进一步研究其病理生理和靶向干预。
items.curatedReasonEn: The thoracolumbar fascia (TLF) in low back pain (LBP) patients differs from healthy individuals, but this is a long way from proving TLF as the primary cause of LBP. More research is needed to elucidate specific pathophysiological mechanisms and targeted interventions.
items.limitation: TLF 的测量方法和定义在纳入的研究中存在异质性，可能影响荟萃分析结果。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in measurement methods and definitions of the TLF across included studies may affect meta-analysis results.

items.title: The effect of SportsMetrics training program on functional performance, landing error, dynamic knee valgus and hamstrings/quadriceps strength in athletes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found that the SportsMetrics training program effectively improves functional performance, reduces landing errors and dynamic knee valgus, and enhances hamstring/quadriceps strength in athletes, supporting its role in injury prevention.
items.curatedReason: SportsMetrics 训练计划是靠谱的。这项系统综述和荟萃分析证实，它能有效改善运动员的功能表现，减少落地失误和膝外翻，并增强股四头肌/腘绳肌力量，确实是预防运动损伤的利器。
items.titleZh: SportsMetrics 训练计划对运动员功能表现、落地误差、动态膝外翻及腘绳肌/股四头肌力量的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析发现，SportsMetrics 训练计划能有效改善运动员的功能表现，减少落地误差和动态膝外翻，并增强腘绳肌/股四头肌力量，支持其在运动损伤预防中的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The SportsMetrics training program is reliable. This systematic review and meta-analysis confirms its effectiveness in improving athletic functional performance, reducing landing errors and dynamic knee valgus, and enhancing hamstring/quadriceps strength, making it a valuable tool for injury prevention.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的异质性可能影响结果的精确性，需要对训练实施细节进行标准化。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity across included studies may affect the precision of the results, and standardization of training implementation details is needed.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Sarcopenia among mid-to-older adults in Southeast Asia: A multi-national systematic review and meta-analysis of prevalence and risk factors
items.summary: A multi-national systematic review and meta-analysis on sarcopenia in mid-to-older adults in Southeast Asia revealed high prevalence and identified key risk factors, underscoring the need for targeted interventions in the region.
items.curatedReason: 东南亚地区中老年人肌少症的患病率很高，且与跌倒、骨折风险密切相关。PT 们需要重视这个地区性的健康问题，并设计有针对性的干预措施。
items.titleZh: 东南亚中老年人群肌少症患病率与危险因素：一项多国系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项关于东南亚中老年人群肌少症患病率与危险因素的多国系统综述和荟萃分析，揭示了该区域的普遍性及相关风险因素，强调了在该地区进行针对性干预的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Sarcopenia is highly prevalent among mid-to-older adults in Southeast Asia and strongly associated with increased risks of falls and fractures. PTs must acknowledge this regional health issue and develop targeted interventions accordingly.
items.limitation: 区域性研究，且不同国家和研究的方法学异质性可能影响荟萃分析结果。
items.limitationEn: This is a regional study, and methodological heterogeneity across different countries and studies may affect meta-analysis results.

items.title: Association Between Danish Guideline Treatments for Breast Cancer and Physiotherapy-Relevant Late Effects: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
items.summary: A Danish nationwide cohort study found that guideline treatments for breast cancer were associated with a risk of physiotherapy-relevant self-reported late effects (shoulder impairment, lymphedema, fatigue) 3-7 years postoperatively, highlighting the need for targeted rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项队列研究提示，接受指南治疗的乳腺癌患者，在术后 3-7 年仍可能面临肩部功能障碍、淋巴水肿和疲劳等物理治疗相关的晚期症状。这应促使临床 PT 关注这些患者，并制定更具针对性的康复策略。
items.titleZh: 丹麦乳腺癌指南治疗与物理治疗相关晚期症状的关联性分析：一项全国性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项丹麦全国性队列研究发现，乳腺癌指南治疗与术后 3-7 年物理治疗相关的自我报告晚期症状（肩部功能障碍、淋巴水肿、疲劳）风险相关，提示需要有针对性的康复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cohort study suggests that breast cancer patients receiving guideline-recommended treatments may still experience physiotherapy-relevant late effects such as shoulder impairment, lymphedema, and fatigue 3-7 years postoperatively. This should prompt clinicians to focus on these patients and develop more targeted rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 研究主要依赖患者自我报告的晚期症状，可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The study relies heavily on self-reported late effects, which may introduce recall bias.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Twenty years of the fitness and mobility exercise (FAME) program for people post-stroke: a multi-data source evaluation of implementation using the RE-AIM framework.
items.summary: A multi-data source evaluation of the Fitness and Mobility Exercise (FAME) program post-stroke found strong evidence through randomized trials and international uptake, indicating successful real-world implementation over 20 years using the RE-AIM framework.
items.curatedReason: FAME 项目的长期评估显示，其证据基础（包括 RCT）和在加拿大多地及国际上的推广接受度均良好。这为社区卒中康复项目提供了可持续实施的经验模型。
items.titleZh: 卒中后 FAME 康复项目二十年：基于 RE-AIM 框架的多数据源实施评估
items.summaryZh: 对卒中后 FAME 康复项目的多数据源评估发现，通过 RCT 和国际推广，其在 20 年间成功实现了现实世界的实施，符合 RE-AIM 框架。
items.curatedReasonEn: Long-term evaluation of the FAME program demonstrates a solid evidence base (including RCTs) and good uptake both domestically and internationally, offering a sustainable implementation model for community-based stroke rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: RE-AIM 框架的评估依赖于公开数据和问卷，可能存在选择性偏差。
items.limitationEn: The RE-AIM framework evaluation relies on publicly available data and surveys, which may be subject to selection bias.

items.title: Rehabilitative game-based exercise integrated into conservative treatment for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis: a pilot randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A pilot randomized controlled trial suggests that integrating rehabilitative game-based exercise into conservative treatment for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis may enhance patient engagement and adherence, warranting further investigation.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点 RCT 提示，将游戏化康复运动整合到青少年特发性脊柱侧凸的保守治疗中，有望提高患者依从性和参与度。这为 PT 提供了探索创新干预模式的思路。
items.titleZh: 康复性游戏化运动整合于青少年特发性脊柱侧凸保守治疗中：一项试点随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项试点随机对照试验表明，将康复性游戏化运动整合到青少年特发性脊柱侧凸的保守治疗中，可能提高患者的参与度和依从性，值得进一步研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that integrating gamified rehabilitative exercises into conservative treatment for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS) holds promise for improving patient adherence and engagement. It offers PTs an avenue to explore innovative intervention models.
items.limitation: 作为试点研究，样本量较小，需要更大规模的 RCT 来确认其有效性。
items.limitationEn: As a pilot study, the sample size is small, and larger RCTs are needed to confirm efficacy.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Multimodal synthesis of neural correlates of motor imagery after spinal cord injury: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review synthesized the neural correlates of motor imagery after spinal cord injury (SCI) using multimodal data, highlighting its potential for understanding retained motor function and informing rehabilitation strategies.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述对脊髓损伤 (SCI) 后运动意象的神经相关性进行了多模态综合分析。结果强调了运动意象在研究 SCI 患者残存运动功能和神经重塑中的作用，为未来康复干预（如脑机接口）提供了理论基础。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤后运动意象的神经相关性多模态综合分析：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述通过多模态数据综合分析了脊髓损伤 (SCI) 后运动意象的神经相关性，强调了其在理解残存运动功能和指导康复策略中的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review provides a multimodal synthesis of neural correlates of motor imagery (MI) after spinal cord injury (SCI). It highlights MI's role in understanding retained motor function and neural plasticity in SCI patients, offering a theoretical basis for future rehabilitation interventions (e.g., brain-computer interfaces).
items.limitation: 研究受限于现有影像学和神经电生理技术的局限性，对运动意象的神经机制仍有待深入。
items.limitationEn: The review is limited by the capabilities of current neuroimaging and electrophysiological techniques, and the neural mechanisms of motor imagery require deeper exploration.

items.title: Phase-specific relationships between cognitive function and life-space mobility in patients with ischemic stroke: implications for geriatric rehabilitation
items.summary: A study exploring phase-specific relationships between cognitive function and life-space mobility in ischemic stroke patients found dynamic reciprocal links, particularly in the recovery phase, implying the need for integrated geriatric rehabilitation strategies.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究揭示了缺血性卒中患者认知功能与生活空间活动度在不同康复阶段存在动态关联，尤其是在恢复期。这提示 PT 在老年康复中应同时关注患者的认知状态和活动范围，并可能需要更综合的干预。
items.titleZh: 缺血性卒中患者认知功能与生活空间活动度的阶段特异性关系：对老年康复的启示
items.summaryZh: 一项关于缺血性卒中患者认知功能与生活空间活动度阶段特异性关系的研究发现，在恢复期存在动态的相互联系，暗示需要整合性的老年康复策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals phase-specific relationships between cognitive function and life-space mobility in patients with ischemic stroke, particularly during the recovery phase. This suggests PTs should simultaneously address cognitive status and mobility in geriatric rehabilitation, potentially requiring integrated interventions.
items.limitation: 研究人群仅限于中国患者，外推性可能受文化和医疗体系差异影响。
items.limitationEn: The study population is limited to Chinese patients, and generalizability may be affected by cultural and healthcare system differences.

items.title: Mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review on mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament (MD-ACL) summarized current knowledge on its pathophysiology, diagnosis, and treatment, highlighting diagnostic challenges and the need for further research into management strategies.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述对前交叉韧带 (ACL) 的黏液样变性进行了全面梳理。它强调了该病变的罕见性、诊断挑战以及现有治疗（如清创术）的局限性，提示需要更深入的病理生理学研究和更优化的治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带黏液样变性：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项关于前交叉韧带 (ACL) 黏液样变性的范围综述，总结了关于其病理生理、诊断和治疗的现有知识，强调了诊断挑战以及对管理策略进行进一步研究的必要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review comprehensively examines mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL). It highlights the rarity, diagnostic challenges, and limitations of current treatments (e.g., debridement), underscoring the need for deeper pathophysiological research and optimized therapeutic approaches.
items.limitation: 作为范围综述，它侧重于概述现有文献，并未对研究设计或证据质量进行严格评估。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, it focuses on mapping the existing literature rather than critically appraising study designs or evidence quality.

items.title: Effect of the WHO ICOPE prevention program on falls and mobility functions : a retrospective study in France
items.summary: A retrospective study in France evaluated the WHO ICOPE prevention program, finding it effective in reducing falls and improving mobility functions in older adults, supporting its role in geriatric rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: WHO ICOPE 综合干预计划在法国的老年人身上验证有效，确实能减少跌倒并改善运动功能。PT 在老年康复领域，可以借鉴其模式。
items.titleZh: WHO ICOPE 预防计划对跌倒和运动功能的影响：一项法国回顾性研究
items.summaryZh: 法国一项评估 WHO ICOPE 预防计划的回顾性研究发现，该计划能有效减少老年人跌倒并改善运动功能，支持其在老年康复中的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The WHO ICOPE comprehensive intervention program has been validated in French older adults, demonstrating effectiveness in reducing falls and improving mobility functions. PTs can adopt its model in geriatric rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 回顾性研究的设计可能存在选择偏差，且研究仅在法国进行，可能受地域因素影响。
items.limitationEn: The retrospective design may be subject to selection bias, and the study's localization to France could be influenced by regional factors.

items.title: A new perspective in predicting fall risk in non-parkinsonian geriatric patients: the magnetic resonance parkinsonism index
items.summary: This study introduces the magnetic resonance parkinsonism index (MRPI) as a potential new tool for predicting fall risk in non-parkinsonian geriatric patients, suggesting a novel approach for assessment.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提出了一个新的预测非帕金森病老年患者跌倒风险的指标——磁共振帕金森指数 (MRPI)。如果该指标能被进一步验证，将为 PT 评估和干预高跌倒风险的老年人群提供新的工具。
items.titleZh: 预测非帕金森病老年患者跌倒风险的新视角：磁共振帕金森指数
items.summaryZh: 该研究提出了磁共振帕金森指数 (MRPI) 作为预测非帕金森病老年患者跌倒风险的新方法，为跌倒风险评估提供了一个新视角。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study proposes the magnetic resonance parkinsonism index (MRPI) as a novel predictor of fall risk in non-parkinsonian geriatric patients. If validated, MRPI could offer PTs a new tool for assessing and intervening with high-fall-risk older populations.
items.limitation: 该指数是初步提出的，其诊断效度和临床实用性需要大规模前瞻性研究来验证。
items.limitationEn: The index is proposed as a novel measure and requires validation through large-scale prospective studies to confirm its diagnostic accuracy and clinical utility.

items.title: Exploring readiness to patient-centered goal-setting in stroke Rehabilitation-A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study exploring readiness for patient-centered goal-setting in stroke rehabilitation found that the process is primarily clinician-led, with limited patient and caregiver involvement, highlighting barriers like uncertainty and communication challenges.
items.curatedReason: 该定性研究揭示，在卒中康复中，目标设定仍以临床医生为主导，患者和照护者的参与有限。要实现真正的以患者为中心，需要克服不确定性并改进沟通策略。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复中以患者为中心目标设定的准备度探索：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项关于卒中康复中以患者为中心目标设定准备度的定性研究发现，该过程主要由临床医生主导，患者和照护者参与有限，存在不确定性和沟通挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals that goal-setting in stroke rehabilitation remains largely clinician-led with limited patient and caregiver involvement. Achieving true patient-centered care requires addressing uncertainty and improving communication strategies.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于特定地区和医疗系统，结果的外推性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: The study's scope is limited to a specific region and healthcare system, potentially limiting the generalizability of findings.

items.title: Effects of high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation on muscle strength, proprioception, cutaneous sensitivity and their relationship with balance in older adults with a history of falls
items.summary: This study explored the effects of high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation (HD-tDCS) on muscle strength, proprioception, and cutaneous sensitivity in older adults with a history of falls, with implications for improving motor function.
items.curatedReason: 老年跌倒高风险人群，高清晰经颅直流电刺激 (HD-tDCS) 也许能改善部分人的力量、本体感觉和触觉，但说它能提升平衡能力还为时过早，别盲目推崇。
items.titleZh: 高清晰经颅直流电刺激对有跌倒史老年人肌肉力量、本体感觉、触觉敏感性及其与平衡关系的影响
items.summaryZh: 该研究探讨了高清晰经颅直流电刺激 (HD-tDCS) 对有跌倒史老年人肌肉力量、本体感觉、触觉敏感性及其与平衡关系的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults at high fall risk, high-definition transcranial direct current stimulation (HD-tDCS) might improve strength, proprioception, and cutaneous sensitivity in some, but claiming it enhances balance is premature. Avoid unsubstantiated enthusiasm.
items.limitation: 研究未明确 HD-tDCS 对平衡能力的直接改善作用，且未报告长期效果。
items.limitationEn: The study did not clearly establish a direct improvement in balance capabilities with HD-tDCS, nor were long-term effects reported.

items.title: Task-oriented circuit training to improve adaptive walking and cognitive-motor function after stroke: a clinical review
items.summary: This clinical review discusses task-oriented circuit training (TOCT) for improving adaptive walking and cognitive-motor function after stroke, emphasizing the need for more comprehensive outcome measures beyond traditional linear metrics.
items.curatedReason: 这篇临床综述讨论了任务导向循环训练 (TOCT) 在改善卒中后适应性行走和认知运动功能方面的应用。尽管 TOCT 是一种常用方法，但作者强调了现有评价指标的局限性，并呼吁采用更全面的评估方法。
items.titleZh: 任务导向循环训练改善卒中后适应性行走与认知运动功能：一篇临床综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇临床综述讨论了任务导向循环训练 (TOCT) 在改善卒中后适应性行走与认知运动功能方面的应用，强调需要超越传统线性指标的更全面结局测量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical review discusses the application of task-oriented circuit training (TOCT) in improving adaptive walking and cognitive-motor function post-stroke. While TOCT is a common approach, the authors highlight limitations in current evaluation metrics and call for more comprehensive assessment methods.
items.limitation: 作为一篇综述，它没有提供新的原始数据，主要依赖已有文献。
items.limitationEn: As a review, it does not present new primary data and relies on existing literature.
items.journal: Bulletin of Faculty of Physical Therapy

items.title: Functional movement screen scores and injury prevalence among collegiate basketball players: a cross-sectional analysis
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis in collegiate basketball players found an association between Functional Movement Screen (FMS) scores and injury prevalence, suggesting FMS might be a useful tool for injury risk assessment, though causality needs further study.
items.curatedReason: 这项横断面分析发现，大学篮球运动员的 FMS 评分与其运动损伤患病率之间存在关联。虽然 FMS 的预测价值仍需进一步研究，但 PT 可以考虑将其作为评估和预防运动员损伤的工具之一。
items.titleZh: 大学生篮球运动员功能性运动筛查评分与损伤患病率：一项横断面分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对大学生篮球运动员的横断面分析发现，功能性运动筛查 (FMS) 评分与损伤患病率相关，提示 FMS 可能作为运动损伤风险评估工具，但因果关系尚需进一步研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional analysis found an association between Functional Movement Screen (FMS) scores and injury prevalence in collegiate basketball players. While the predictive value of FMS requires further investigation, PTs may consider it as one tool for assessing and preventing athletic injuries.
items.limitation: 横断面研究无法确定因果关系，FMS 评分与损伤之间的关系可能受其他混杂因素影响。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, it cannot establish causality, and the relationship between FMS scores and injuries may be influenced by other confounding factors.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Exploratory analysis of the impact of age stratification on outcomes of combined Salter osteotomy and femoral osteotomy in pediatric developmental dysplasia of the hip using a 3-year cutoff
items.summary: An exploratory analysis investigating age stratification in pediatric hip dysplasia surgery suggests a 3-year cutoff may differentiate surgical outcomes, providing insights for PTs in tailoring post-operative rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性分析考察了年龄分层对儿科髋关节发育不良 (DDH) 手术效果的影响。结果提示，3 岁可能是区分不同手术预后的一个有价值的界限，为 PT 在制定个体化术后康复计划时提供了参考。
items.titleZh: 年龄分层对儿童髋关节发育不良联合截骨术结局的影响：一项基于 3 岁分界点的探索性分析
items.summaryZh: 一项关于儿童髋关节发育不良联合截骨术年龄分层影响的探索性分析表明，3 岁分界点可能区分不同的手术结局，为 PT 制定个体化术后康复提供参考。
items.curatedReasonEn: Regarding surgical outcomes for pediatric developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH), a 3-year age cutoff appears to be a noteworthy differentiator. However, as this is an exploratory analysis, PTs can consider it when designing post-operative rehabilitation plans, but it should not be treated as definitive.
items.limitation: 研究为探索性分析，样本量有限，且手术方案并非完全标准化，需要进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study is an exploratory analysis with a limited sample size, and surgical protocols were not fully standardized, requiring further validation.

items.title: Intrinsic capacity decline and multilevel intervention needs of disabled older adults in nursing homes: a qualitative study based on the social-ecological systems theory
items.summary: A qualitative study based on social-ecological systems theory explored intrinsic capacity decline and multilevel intervention needs of disabled older adults in nursing homes, providing insights into complex care requirements.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究基于社会生态系统理论，探讨了养老院残疾老年人的内在能力下降及多层次干预需求。研究结果为 PT 提供了理解老年人复杂需求的视角，并提示了制定综合性干预措施的方向。
items.titleZh: 养老院残疾老年人的内在能力下降与多层次干预需求：一项基于社会生态系统理论的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项基于社会生态系统理论的定性研究，探讨了养老院残疾老年人的内在能力下降及多层次干预需求，为理解复杂照护需求提供了见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: Based on social-ecological systems theory, this qualitative study explores intrinsic capacity decline and multilevel intervention needs of disabled older adults in nursing homes. The findings offer PTs a perspective on understanding the complex needs of older individuals and suggest directions for comprehensive intervention strategies.
items.limitation: 定性研究，结果的普遍性和可推广性受限于参与者的背景和研究环境。
items.limitationEn: As a qualitative study, the findings' generalizability is limited by the participants' background and the research context.

items.title: The effect of tilt-table robot-assisted training on functional outcomes in people with stroke and sarcopenia: a retrospective cohort study
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study on tilt-table robot-assisted training in stroke patients with and without sarcopenia suggested that sarcopenia may affect functional recovery, but findings require validation in larger prospective trials.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，卒中合并肌少症可能影响功能恢复，但作为回顾性研究，还不足以说机器人辅助训练就能显著改善所有卒中患者的功能。期待未来更大样本的前瞻性研究。
items.titleZh: 倾斜床机器人辅助训练对卒中合并肌少症患者功能结局的影响：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项关于倾斜床机器人辅助训练对卒中合并肌少症患者功能结局的回顾性队列研究提示，肌少症可能影响功能恢复，但结果有待更大规模前瞻性研究证实。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests sarcopenia may impact functional recovery in stroke patients, but as a retrospective analysis, it cannot definitively conclude that robot-assisted training significantly improves outcomes for all. Larger prospective trials are needed.
items.limitation: 回顾性研究设计本身存在局限，且样本量相对较小，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The retrospective design has inherent limitations, and the relatively small sample size restricts the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Evaluation of GFAP, UCH-L1 and S100B Blood Biomarkers for the Management of Sports-Related Concussion in Professional Rugby Players: A Prospective Observational Study
items.summary: A prospective observational study evaluated GFAP, UCH-L1, and S100B blood biomarkers for managing sports-related concussion (SRC) in professional rugby players, suggesting potential but insufficient evidence for routine clinical use.
items.curatedReason: 用 GFAP、UCH-L1 和 S100B 这几个生物标志物来管运动相关脑震荡 (SRC)？虽然有潜力，但目前还远未达到能在临床上常规使用的标准，别过早依赖。
items.titleZh: GFAP、UCH-L1 和 S100B 血液生物标志物在职业橄榄球运动员运动相关脑震荡管理中的评估：一项前瞻性观察研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对职业橄榄球运动员的血液生物标志物 GFAP、UCH-L1 和 S100B 在运动相关脑震荡 (SRC) 管理中的评估前瞻性研究，提示其有潜力，但尚无足够证据支持常规临床应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Using GFAP, UCH-L1, and S100B biomarkers for managing sports-related concussion (SRC)? While they show potential, they are currently insufficient for routine clinical use. Do not rely on them prematurely.
items.limitation: 该研究为观察性研究，样本量和随访时间有限，需要更大规模的 RCT 来验证其临床效用。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study with limited sample size and follow-up duration; larger RCTs are needed to validate its clinical utility.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Ahpra appoints new head of its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) announced the appointment of a new head for its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局 (Ahpra) 任命了其原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门的新负责人。这则新闻是关于机构人事任命，与 PT 的临床实践没有直接关联。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局 (Ahpra) 任命其原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门新负责人
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管局 (Ahpra) 宣布任命其原住民和托雷斯海峡岛民健康战略部门的新负责人。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) appointed a new head for its Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Strategy Unit. This news concerns an organizational personnel appointment and has no direct relevance to the clinical practice of physical therapists.

items.title: Effects of Fingertip Vibrotactile Stimulation on Postural Control in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: A Comparison Across Age Groups
items.summary: A study with 348 community-dwelling older adults (aged 65-85+) found that fingertip vibrotactile stimulation affects postural control, with potential differences observed across young-old (65-74), old-old (75-84), and oldest-old (85+) age groups when standing with eyes closed.
items.curatedReason: 指尖振动触觉刺激对社区老年人姿态控制的干预，可能作为跌倒预防策略的辅助手段。但要注意，该研究属于预印本，尚未经过同行评审，且不同年龄段老人的具体效应差异仍待更深入的数据验证。
items.titleZh: 指尖振动触觉刺激对社区老年人姿态控制的影响：一项跨年龄组比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 348 名社区老年人（65-85+ 岁）的研究发现，指尖振动触觉刺激影响姿态控制，在闭眼站立时，年轻老年组（65-74）、高龄老年组（75-84）和最高龄老年组（85+）之间可能存在差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Fingertip vibrotactile stimulation for postural control in community-dwelling older adults could serve as an adjunct in fall prevention strategies. However, note that this is a preprint and has not undergone peer review, and specific effect differences across age groups require further data validation.
items.limitation: 本研究为预印本，尚未经过同行评审，且未报告具体刺激参数及干预方案细节。
items.limitationEn: This is a preprint and has not undergone peer review, and specific stimulation parameters and intervention protocol details were not reported.

items.title: Accelerated Return to Competition Following a Full-Thickness Abdominal Wall Tear in an Elite Sprinter: A Data-informed Case Report.
items.summary: A case report details the accelerated rehabilitation and return-to-competition process for a 22-year-old elite sprinter who sustained a full-thickness tear of the external oblique, internal oblique, and transversus abdominis muscles during block acceleration.
items.curatedReason: 这份病例报告展示了精英短跑运动员腹壁全层撕裂的加速康复流程，为你处理类似罕见但要求高水平表现的运动损伤提供了实操案例和决策参考，尤其是在重返赛场方面。
items.titleZh: 精英短跑运动员腹壁全层撕裂后加速重返赛场：一项数据驱动的病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一份病例报告详细介绍了对一名 22 岁精英短跑运动员腹壁外斜肌、内斜肌和腹横肌全层撕裂后的加速康复及重返赛场过程。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report details an accelerated rehabilitation process for a full-thickness abdominal wall tear in an elite sprinter, offering practical insights and decision-making guidance for similar rare but high-performance sports injuries, particularly regarding return-to-competition.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，结论的外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, limiting the generalizability of its findings.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Effectiveness of Telerehabilitation Versus Conventional Rehabilitation on Motor Function and Activities of Daily Living After Stroke: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review of four RCTs (n=226) found telerehabilitation to be non-inferior to conventional physiotherapy for improving motor function (Fugl-Meyer Assessment) and activities of daily living (Barthel Index) in stroke patients.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后远程康复与传统康复在运动功能和日常生活活动能力上无显著差异，这基本坐实了远程模式作为一种可行的替代方案。你可以将远程康复纳入常规临床路径。
items.titleZh: 卒中后远程康复与传统康复对运动功能和日常生活活动能力有效性的系统综述：随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 4 项 RCT（共 226 名患者）的系统综述显示，卒中后远程康复与传统物理治疗在改善运动功能（Fugl-Meyer 评估）和日常生活活动能力（Barthel 指数）方面无显著劣效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telerehabilitation shows non-inferiority to conventional therapy for motor function and ADLs post-stroke, firmly establishing it as a viable alternative. Integrate telerehabilitation into your standard clinical pathways.
items.limitation: 本系统综述仅纳入四项RCT，样本量较小（226名参与者），且研究异质性可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review included only four RCTs with a small sample size (226 participants), and heterogeneity among studies may limit generalizability.

items.title: Arm exercise training in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
items.summary: An umbrella review synthesized evidence on arm exercise training for patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), confirming its role as a component of pulmonary rehabilitation for managing extrapulmonary features.
items.curatedReason: 这项伞形综述强化了上肢运动训练在慢阻肺康复中的作用。你可以更自信地将上肢运动纳入你的肺康复方案，以管理患者的肺外症状。
items.titleZh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者的上肢运动训练：一项系统综述和荟萃分析的伞形综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项伞形综述综合了关于慢性阻塞性肺疾病 (COPD) 患者上肢运动训练的证据，确认其作为肺康复的一部分在管理肺外特征方面的作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review reinforces the role of arm exercise training in COPD rehabilitation. You can more confidently integrate arm exercises into your pulmonary rehabilitation programs to manage extrapulmonary symptoms.
items.limitation: 伞形综述的局限性在于其依赖于所纳入的系统综述和荟萃分析的质量，且可能存在报告偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The limitation of an umbrella review is its reliance on the quality of the included systematic reviews and meta-analyses, and potential for reporting bias.

items.title: Therapeutic Exercise Protocol During Hospitalization in Pediatric Oncohematological Patients: Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial (n=30) found a therapeutic exercise program for hospitalized pediatric oncohematological patients improved quality of life, muscle strength, fatigue, and functional capacity compared to minimal active physiotherapy.
items.curatedReason: 针对住院的肿瘤血液病患儿，早期治疗性运动方案是可行的，并初步显示出改善生活质量、肌肉力量和功能容量的潜力。将运动作为辅助治疗整合进儿科肿瘤患者的照护中。
items.titleZh: 住院儿科肿瘤血液病患者的治疗性运动方案：随机临床试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机临床试验（n=30）发现，住院儿科肿瘤血液病患者的治疗性运动方案相较于最低限度的主动物理治疗，能改善生活质量、肌肉力量、疲劳感和功能容量。
items.curatedReasonEn: Early therapeutic exercise is feasible for hospitalized pediatric oncohematology patients and shows preliminary potential to improve quality of life, muscle strength, and functional capacity. Integrate exercise as an adjunct therapy into pediatric oncology care.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（30名参与者），且为单中心研究，可能影响结果的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (30 participants) and is single-center, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Comparative Efficacy of Body Acupuncture, Electroacupuncture, and Auricular Acupuncture in Stroke Rehabilitation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 21 RCTs found acupuncture significantly improved motor function in stroke survivors compared to controls (SMD=6.48; 95% CI=4.72-8.24; P<0.001), with electroacupuncture showing the greatest efficacy among body, electro-, and auricular acupuncture.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量的网状 Meta 分析再次确认针灸对卒中运动功能恢复的有效性，并提示电针效果最佳。在处理卒中患者时，电针应是你考虑的辅助干预手段之一，尤其是在运动功能受损明显的患者中。
items.titleZh: 中风康复中体针、电针和耳针的比较疗效：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 21 项 RCT 的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，与对照组相比，针灸显著改善了卒中幸存者的运动功能（SMD=6.48；95% CI=4.72-8.24；P<0.001），其中电针在体针、电针和耳针中显示出最佳疗效。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality network meta-analysis reconfirms acupuncture's effectiveness in stroke motor recovery, with electroacupuncture showing the greatest benefit. Consider electroacupuncture as an adjunctive intervention for stroke patients, especially those with significant motor deficits.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学异质性可能影响结果的综合解释。
items.limitationEn: Methodological heterogeneity among included studies might impact the synthesis of results.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Neuralgic Amyotrophy Following Rotator Cuff Repair: A Patient's Experience.
items.summary: A 64-year-old male developed severe periscapular pain and weakness consistent with neuralgic amyotrophy eight days post-arthroscopic rotator cuff repair, showing slow but substantial functional recovery after prolonged physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 肩袖修复术后出现臂丛神经炎极少见，但这个病例提醒你 PT 需警惕术后疼痛和无力的罕见原因。它不改变常规康复方案，但可作为鉴别诊断的参考。
items.titleZh: 肩袖修复术后臂丛神经炎：一例患者的经历
items.summaryZh: 一名 64 岁男性在关节镜下肩袖修复术后 8 天出现与臂丛神经炎一致的严重肩胛周疼痛和无力，经过长时间物理治疗后功能恢复缓慢但显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: Neuralgic amyotrophy post-rotator cuff repair is rare, but this case reminds PTs to consider uncommon causes of pain and weakness after surgery. It doesn't alter routine rehab protocols but serves as a differential diagnostic reference.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，外推性非常有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report with very limited generalizability.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Exercise prescription: Physiotherapy's most important and least standardized skill.
items.summary: This commentary highlights that exercise prescription in musculoskeletal physiotherapy is a critical yet unstandardized skill, leading to inconsistencies in decision-making and communication, and calls for systematic approaches.
items.curatedReason: 运动处方是物理治疗的核心技能，但其标准化程度不足，可能导致临床实践和研究中的不一致。这份述评强调了建立共享语言和系统化流程的必要性，促使你重新审视自己的处方决策和沟通策略。
items.titleZh: 运动处方：物理治疗中最重要但标准化程度最低的技能
items.summaryZh: 这份述评指出，肌肉骨骼物理治疗中的运动处方是一项关键但标准化程度不足的技能，导致决策和沟通不一致，并呼吁采取系统化方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise prescription is a core PT skill, yet its lack of standardization can lead to inconsistencies in practice and research. This commentary highlights the need for shared language and systematic processes, prompting you to re-evaluate your own prescription decisions and communication strategies.

items.title: From Injury to Inclusion: Evidence From the International Spinal Cord Injury Survey (InSCI).
items.summary: An evidence map of the International Spinal Cord Injury Community Survey (InSCI) identified 117 peer-reviewed publications by April 2026, with healthcare needs and epidemiology being the largest categories, revealing key research areas and knowledge gaps.
items.curatedReason: 这份InSCI证据地图提示我们，脊髓损伤领域的研究热点主要集中在医疗需求和流行病学，这有助于你了解当前哪些方向已有较多数据积累，哪些仍是空白。在临床实践中，可以考虑将重心放在现有证据较强的领域，同时识别出你的患者在研究薄弱环节可能存在的未被满足的需求。
items.titleZh: 从损伤到融合：国际脊髓损伤调查（InSCI）的证据
items.summaryZh: 国际脊髓损伤社区调查（InSCI）的证据地图显示，截至 2026 年 4 月已产生 117 篇同行评审出版物，其中医疗需求和流行病学是最大的类别，揭示了关键研究领域和知识空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: The International Spinal Cord Injury Survey (InSCI) has generated a significant body of evidence, and this evidence map helps you understand current research priorities and knowledge gaps in SCI. Focusing on these high-frequency themes can better guide your clinical practice and research directions.
items.limitation: 本研究为证据地图，不提供具体的临床干预效果数据。
items.limitationEn: This study is an evidence map and does not provide specific clinical intervention efficacy data.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Integrated rehabilitation incorporating aquatic therapy following posterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: a case report.
items.summary: A case report of a 51-year-old woman showed that integrated rehabilitation incorporating aquatic therapy after PCL reconstruction helped facilitate early functional recovery by minimizing stress on the reconstructed ligament.
items.curatedReason: 后交叉韧带重建术后的康复非常棘手，水疗提供了一个低负重环境，可以促进早期功能恢复。这份病例报告为 PCL 术后早期水疗的应用提供了初步参考，但临床实践中仍需更多证据支持。
items.titleZh: 后交叉韧带重建术后结合水疗的整合康复：一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 一份病例报告显示，一名 51 岁女性在后交叉韧带重建术后通过结合水疗的整合康复，在减少重建韧带压力的同时，促进了早期功能恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: PCL reconstruction rehabilitation is challenging, and aquatic therapy offers a low-load environment that may facilitate early functional recovery. This case report provides preliminary insight into early aquatic therapy post-PCL, but more evidence is needed for routine clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，证据级别低，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report with a low level of evidence and limited generalizability.

items.title: When algorithms don't care: physiotherapy and the post-professional turn.
items.summary: A perspective piece arguing that physiotherapy is entering a post-professional era due to late-stage capitalism, unbundling of professional claims, and digitally mediated technological disruption, which may marginalize practitioners in care delivery.
items.curatedReason: 我们必须警惕物理治疗行业可能进入“后专业时代”，其中AI和数字化技术将边缘化临床执业者在协调和提供医疗服务中的核心地位。现在就该思考如何转型，以应对这种由晚期资本主义、专业主张解构和技术颠覆带来的结构性挑战。
items.titleZh: 当算法不再关心：物理治疗与“后专业时代”的转向
items.summaryZh: 一篇视角文章指出，受晚期资本主义、专业声誉解绑和数字化技术颠覆等多重力量驱动，物理治疗行业正进入一个“后专业时代”，可能导致执业者在医疗协调和提供中的作用被边缘化。
items.curatedReasonEn: Be warned: physiotherapy may be entering a 'post-professional era,' where AI and digital tech marginalize practitioners in care coordination and delivery. It's time to consider how to adapt your role to these structural challenges, driven by late-stage capitalism, the unbundling of professional claims, and technological disruption.

items.title: Biopsychosocial predictors of functional recovery in chronic low back pain following physiotherapy: A survival analysis study.
items.summary: A prospective observational cohort study of 250 adults with chronic low back pain found that biopsychosocial characteristics predict functional recovery timing after a median of eight physiotherapy sessions over four weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入 250 名患者的观察性研究提示，慢性下腰痛患者在平均 8 次物理治疗（持续 4 周）后的功能恢复时间点，与生物心理社会特征密切相关。你在评估患者预后时，应更重视这些综合因素，而非单纯依赖症状。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗后慢性下腰痛功能恢复的生物心理社会预测因素：一项生存分析研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性观察性队列研究纳入 250 名慢性非特异性下腰痛患者，发现基线生物心理社会特征能预测经过平均八次物理治疗（四周内）后的功能恢复时间点。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study of 250 patients suggests that biopsychosocial characteristics predict the timing of functional recovery in chronic low back pain patients after a median of eight physiotherapy sessions over four weeks. When assessing prognosis, prioritize these integrated factors rather than solely relying on symptoms.
items.limitation: 研究样本量为 250 名患者，且随访时间中位数为四周围绕，可能限制了长期恢复预测的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size of 250 patients and a median follow-up of four weeks may limit the generalizability of long-term recovery predictions.

items.title: Manifestations of Oral Muscle Mass, Tongue Strength, and Endurance in Patients with Stroke Across Varying Degrees of Swallowing Function: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional pilot study of 41 stroke patients found differences in oral muscle mass, elasticity, and tongue performance across varying levels of swallowing function, as assessed by ultrasonography and tongue dynamometry.
items.curatedReason: 这项试点研究提供了卒中患者在不同吞咽功能水平下口腔肌肉质量、舌肌力量和耐力的初步数据。这些客观指标有助于你评估卒中后吞咽障碍的严重程度，并指导康复训练的方向，为个性化治疗提供依据。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者不同吞咽功能水平下的口腔肌肉质量、舌肌力量和耐力表现：一项试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 41 名卒中患者的横断面试点研究发现，通过超声和舌力计评估的口腔肌肉质量、弹性及舌功能在不同吞咽功能水平之间存在差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study provides preliminary data on oral muscle mass, tongue strength, and endurance in stroke patients with varying degrees of swallowing function. These objective measures can help you assess the severity of post-stroke dysphagia and guide rehabilitation training, supporting personalized treatment.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的横断面试点研究（41 名患者），其发现需在大规模纵向研究中进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a small-sample cross-sectional pilot study (41 patients), and its findings require further validation in larger longitudinal studies.

items.title: Applying the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health to Classify Upper Limb Outcome Measures in Stroke Rehabilitation: A Construct-Driven Perspective.
items.summary: This perspective piece argues for applying the ICF framework to classify upper limb outcome measures in stroke rehabilitation, prioritizing scoring criteria over item content to better distinguish neuromuscular impairments from activity limitations.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文章讨论了如何利用国际功能、残疾和健康分类 (ICF) 框架来更清晰地分类卒中康复中上肢功能评估量表，区分神经肌肉障碍和活动受限。这能帮助你更准确地选择和解读评估工具，优化康复计划。
items.titleZh: 应用国际功能、残疾和健康分类 (ICF) 框架对卒中康复中上肢功能评估量表进行分类：一种结构驱动的视角
items.summaryZh: 这篇视角文章提出，应应用 ICF 框架对卒中康复中的上肢结局测量工具进行分类，优先考虑评分标准而非项目内容，以更好地区分神经肌肉障碍和活动受限。
items.curatedReasonEn: When classifying upper limb outcome measures in stroke rehabilitation, prioritize the ICF framework and focus on scoring criteria over item content. This approach will enable you to more precisely differentiate between neuromuscular impairments and activity limitations, thereby optimizing rehabilitation strategies.

items.title: Temporal dissociation between heart rate recovery and heart rate variability recovery after submaximal exercise in healthy older adults
items.summary: A study in healthy older adults found a temporal dissociation between heart rate recovery and heart rate variability recovery after submaximal exercise.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现健康老年人在次最大运动后心率恢复与心率变异性恢复存在时间上的解离。这一发现提示你在评估老年人的运动恢复能力时，不应仅仅依赖心率恢复，还应考虑其他自主神经指标。
items.titleZh: 健康老年人次最大运动后心率恢复与心率变异性恢复的时间性解离
items.summaryZh: 一项针对健康老年人的研究发现，在次最大运动后，心率恢复与心率变异性恢复存在时间上的解离。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found a temporal dissociation between heart rate recovery and heart rate variability recovery after submaximal exercise in healthy older adults. This suggests that when assessing exercise recovery capacity in older adults, you should not rely solely on heart rate recovery, but also consider other autonomic nervous system indicators.
items.limitation: 这是一项针对健康老年人的研究，其结果不一定适用于伴有心血管疾病或其他共病的老年患者。
items.limitationEn: This study focused on healthy older adults, and its findings may not be applicable to older patients with cardiovascular diseases or other comorbidities.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity

items.title: Cardiovascular and autonomic responses to transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation combined with activity-based therapy after chronic spinal cord injury: An exploratory study from the MACHINE trial
items.summary: An exploratory case series (n=8) from the MACHINE trial investigated cardiovascular and autonomic responses to body weight-supported treadmill training combined with active or sham transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation in chronic, motor-complete spinal cord injury.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究报告了慢性脊髓损伤患者结合经皮脊髓电刺激（TSCS）和基于活动的疗法（BWSTT）时，心血管和自主神经的反应。它提示了这种联合干预对改善自主功能障碍的潜在效果，为未来临床研究提供了方向。
items.titleZh: 慢性脊髓损伤后经皮脊髓电刺激联合活动训练对心血管和自主神经反应的影响：MACHINE 试验的探索性研究
items.summaryZh: MACHINE 试验的一项探索性病例系列研究（n=8）评估了慢性、运动完全性脊髓损伤患者在体重支持跑台训练联合主动或假性经皮脊髓电刺激后，心血管和自主神经的反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study reports cardiovascular and autonomic responses to transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation (TSCS) combined with activity-based therapy (BWSTT) in chronic spinal cord injury patients. It suggests the potential for this combined intervention to improve autonomic dysfunction, providing direction for future clinical research.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性病例系列研究，样本量非常小（8 名参与者），结果不应直接推广至临床实践。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory case series with a very small sample size (8 participants), and the results should not be generalized to clinical practice.

items.title: Unstable-surface squats are associated with lower postural stability indices but not interlimb sway asymmetry in healthy young adults
items.summary: A study in healthy young adults found that unstable-surface squats were associated with lower postural stability indices but not interlimb sway asymmetry.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，在不稳定平面上进行深蹲与较低的姿势稳定性指数相关，但在健康年轻人中未观察到肢体间摇摆不对称。这提示你，不稳定平面训练确实能挑战姿势控制，但在特定人群中可能对姿势不对称的影响有限。
items.titleZh: 健康青年人在不稳定平面上深蹲与较低的姿势稳定性指数相关，但与肢体间摇摆不对称无关
items.summaryZh: 一项针对健康年轻人的研究发现，在不稳定平面上进行深蹲与较低的姿势稳定性指数相关，但与肢体间摇摆不对称无关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that squats on an unstable surface were associated with lower postural stability indices but not interlimb sway asymmetry in healthy young adults. This suggests that unstable surface training indeed challenges postural control, but its effect on postural asymmetry may be limited in specific populations.
items.limitation: 这项研究对象为健康年轻人，其发现不能直接外推至老年人、损伤恢复人群或表现训练场景。
items.limitationEn: This study focused on healthy young adults, and its findings cannot be directly extrapolated to older adults, rehabilitation populations, or performance training settings.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Machine learning analysis of demographic, rehabilitation, and performance factors associated with Olympic medal productivity in elite athletes
items.summary: A machine learning analysis investigated demographic, rehabilitation, and performance factors associated with Olympic medal productivity in elite athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这项机器学习分析提示，精英运动员的奥运奖牌产出与人口学、康复和运动表现因素相关。虽然是观察性研究，但它为你制定高水平运动员的训练和康复策略提供了一个新的视角，尤其在识别潜在影响因素上。
items.titleZh: 机器学习分析人口学、康复和表现因素与精英运动员奥运奖牌产出关联
items.summaryZh: 一项机器学习分析研究了人口学、康复和运动表现因素与精英运动员奥运奖牌产出之间的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This machine learning analysis suggests an association between Olympic medal productivity in elite athletes and demographic, rehabilitation, and performance factors. While observational, it offers a fresh perspective for designing training and rehabilitation strategies for high-level athletes, particularly in identifying potential influencing factors.
items.limitation: 研究的关联性发现不等于因果关系，且模型可能受限于特定运动员群体的数据特征。
items.limitationEn: The correlational findings of the study do not imply causation, and the model may be limited by the data characteristics of specific athlete populations.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Effectiveness and feasibility of home-based physical exercise interventions for children and adolescents with chronic diseases: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found home-based physical exercise interventions for children and adolescents with chronic diseases were effective in improving aerobic capacity, functional capacity, muscle strength, and quality of life, and were feasible, although reporting quality varied.
items.curatedReason: 对于患有慢性疾病的儿童和青少年，居家体育锻炼干预是有效的，它能改善有氧能力、功能能力、肌肉力量和生活质量。尽管报告质量有差异，但你应该大胆地将运动处方整合到他们的居家康复方案中。
items.titleZh: 居家体育锻炼干预对慢性病儿童和青少年的有效性和可行性：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析发现，居家体育锻炼干预对慢性病儿童和青少年在改善有氧能力、功能能力、肌肉力量和生活质量方面有效且可行，但研究报告质量参差不齐。
items.curatedReasonEn: Home-based physical exercise interventions are effective for children and adolescents with chronic diseases, improving aerobic capacity, functional capacity, muscle strength, and quality of life. Despite some variability in reporting quality, you should confidently integrate exercise prescriptions into their home-based rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的报告质量不一，可能影响干预方案的可重复性和可扩展性。
items.limitationEn: The reporting quality of included studies varied, which might affect the reproducibility and scalability of interventions.

items.title: Joint non-linear dose-response associations of device-measured physical activity and cardiorespiratory fitness with cardiovascular disease: a cohort and Mendelian randomisation study
items.summary: A UK Biobank cohort study with Mendelian randomization found a non-linear joint dose-response relationship between accelerometer-measured MVPA and cardiorespiratory fitness (CRF) with incident cardiovascular disease, showing greater benefits from combining both.
items.curatedReason: 这项联合分析发现，中高强度身体活动（MVPA）和心肺适能（CRF）与心血管疾病风险存在非线性剂量反应关系，并且两者结合能带来更大的益处。这进一步强化了运动处方中综合考虑运动量和身体素质的必要性，并提示你应致力于提升患者的整体适能水平。
items.titleZh: 设备测量身体活动和心肺适能与心血管疾病的联合非线性剂量反应关联：一项队列和孟德尔随机化研究
items.summaryZh: 一项结合孟德尔随机化的英国生物银行队列研究发现，加速计测量的中高强度身体活动（MVPA）和心肺适能（CRF）与心血管疾病发生率之间存在非线性联合剂量反应关系，表明两者结合能带来更大的益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This joint analysis found a non-linear dose-response relationship between moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA) and cardiorespiratory fitness (CRF) with cardiovascular disease risk, with combined benefits. This reinforces the necessity of comprehensively considering both exercise volume and fitness levels in exercise prescription and suggests you should focus on improving patients' overall fitness.
items.limitation: MR分析的因果推断可能受到遗传变异假定的限制。
items.limitationEn: Causal inference from MR analysis might be limited by genetic variation assumptions.

items.title: More Than Just Arm Movement: Finger-Worn Accelerometers Provide a Valid and Sensitive Alternative to Wrist-Worn Accelerometers for Measuring Real-World Upper-Limb Performance in Stroke Survivors
items.summary: A cross-sectional observational study of 20 stroke survivors demonstrated that finger-worn accelerometers provide a valid and sensitive alternative to wrist-worn accelerometers for measuring real-world upper-limb motor performance, capturing more nuanced movements.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究证实了指戴式加速计在测量卒中幸存者真实世界中上肢运动表现的临床有效性和敏感性，优于腕戴式。你应考虑将指戴式设备纳入未来上肢康复评估和监测方案，以获取更精准的功能数据。
items.titleZh: 不仅仅是手臂运动：指戴式加速计为卒中幸存者真实世界上肢功能测量提供了一种有效且敏感的替代腕戴式方案
items.summaryZh: 一项对20名卒中幸存者的横断面观察研究表明，指戴式加速计在测量真实世界上肢运动表现方面，提供了一种比腕戴式加速计更有效且敏感的替代方案，能捕捉更细微的动作。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study confirmed the clinical validity and sensitivity of finger-worn accelerometers for measuring real-world upper-limb motor performance in stroke survivors, outperforming wrist-worn devices. You should consider integrating finger-worn devices into future upper-limb rehabilitation assessment and monitoring protocols to obtain more precise functional data.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且仅限于轻中度上肢损伤的卒中幸存者，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size and was limited to stroke survivors with mild-to-moderate upper-limb impairment, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Switzerland: the European crossroad of sports eligibility decision-making in athletes with cardiovascular conditions
items.summary: This commentary discusses the paradigm shift in sports eligibility decision-making for athletes with cardiovascular conditions, moving from a physician-centric approach to one that integrates patient autonomy and shared decision-making, in line with evolving medical ethics.
items.curatedReason: 运动心脏病学领域，运动员心脏病史的参赛资格决策正在转型。现在需要将患者自主权和共享决策融入进来，而不是单纯由医生主导。
items.titleZh: 瑞士：欧洲心脏病运动员运动资格决策的十字路口
items.summaryZh: 本述评探讨了心脏病运动员运动资格决策的模式转变，从传统的医生单方面决策转向整合患者自主权的共享决策，这与过去二十年医疗伦理的发展相符。
items.curatedReasonEn: In sports cardiology, athlete eligibility decisions for those with cardiac conditions are shifting. You need to integrate patient autonomy and shared decision-making, moving away from a purely physician-centric approach.

items.title: Epistemic injustice in sports medicine: framing return-to-play beyond hard data
items.summary: This commentary argues for framing return-to-play decisions in sports medicine beyond objective 'hard data,' emphasizing the integration of clinical, physiological, psychological, and ethical considerations due to its complex and high-pressure nature.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评提醒你，运动重返决策远不止是量化数据，还涉及运动员的心理、社会期望和伦理考量。在评估复杂案例时，你应将这些多维度因素纳入考量。
items.titleZh: 运动医学中的认识论不公正：超越硬数据的重返赛场框架
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评主张将运动重返决策框架扩展到客观的“硬数据”之外，强调在复杂和高压环境中整合临床、生理、心理和伦理考量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary reminds you that return-to-play decisions extend beyond quantitative data, involving an athlete's psychology, social expectations, and ethical considerations. You should integrate these multidimensional factors when evaluating complex cases.

items.title: Need to train clinicians for physical activity and exercise interventions: a call to action
items.summary: This call to action emphasizes the critical need to train clinicians for physical activity and exercise interventions, citing their proven effectiveness for chronic diseases despite limited implementation due to lack of awareness, knowledge, and infrastructure.
items.curatedReason: 这篇呼吁强调临床医生在身体活动和运动干预方面的培训不足。你作为物理治疗师，正是在填补这一空白，但它也提示你，在跨专业协作中仍需加强教育和倡导，以提升运动处方在医疗系统中的地位。
items.titleZh: 需要培训临床医生进行身体活动和运动干预：一项行动呼吁
items.summaryZh: 这项行动呼吁强调了培训临床医生进行身体活动和运动干预的迫切需求，指出尽管其对慢性病疗效已证实，但由于缺乏意识、知识和基础设施，实施仍受限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This call highlights the inadequate training of clinicians in physical activity and exercise interventions. As a physical therapist, you are directly addressing this gap, but it also suggests the ongoing need for enhanced education and advocacy in interprofessional collaboration to elevate the role of exercise prescription within healthcare systems.

items.title: Optimal 24-hour movement behaviour compositions across trimesters and risk of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy: the Pregnancy 24/7 cohort study
items.summary: The Pregnancy 24/7 cohort study (N=500) identified optimal 24-hour movement behavior compositions (MVPA, LPA, sedentary behavior, sleep) across all trimesters were associated with a lower risk of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
items.curatedReason: 这项纳入500名孕妇的队列研究提示，优化全天24小时的运动行为组合（包括中高强度、低强度活动、久坐和睡眠），可能降低妊娠期高血压疾病风险。在指导孕期患者时，别只关注单一运动形式，要综合考虑全天候的活动模式。
items.titleZh: 孕期24小时运动行为组成与妊娠期高血压疾病风险：妊娠24/7队列研究
items.summaryZh: 妊娠24/7队列研究（N=500）发现，孕期所有三个阶段中，24小时运动行为（中高强度活动、低强度活动、久坐行为和睡眠）的最佳组合与妊娠期高血压疾病风险降低相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cohort study of 500 pregnant individuals suggests optimizing the 24-hour movement behavior composition—including MVPA, LPA, sedentary behavior, and sleep—across all trimesters may be associated with a lower risk of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy. When advising pregnant patients, don't just focus on single exercise forms; consider their entire 24/7 activity pattern.
items.limitation: 研究主要为观察性，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The study was primarily observational and could not establish causality.

items.title: Inspiratory Strength Training in Pediatric Cardiac Critical Care: A Retrospective Cohort Study
items.summary: A single-center retrospective cohort study of children with congenital heart disease (N=75) in the PCICU found inspiratory strength training (IST) was feasible (96% completion) and safe, with positive physiological responses, suggesting its benefit for weaning from mechanical ventilation.
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性队列研究表明，吸气肌力量训练（IST）在儿科心脏重症监护室（PCICU）中是可行且安全的，并能改善生理反应。这为你在儿科重症监护环境中应用IST提供了初步证据。
items.titleZh: 吸气肌力量训练在儿科心脏重症监护中的应用：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对PCICU中患有先天性心脏病儿童（N=75）的单中心回顾性队列研究发现，吸气肌力量训练（IST）可行（96%完成率）且安全，并伴有积极的生理反应，提示其有助于机械通气脱机。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective cohort study indicates that inspiratory strength training (IST) is feasible and safe in the pediatric cardiac intensive care unit (PCICU) and improves physiological responses. This provides preliminary evidence for your application of IST in pediatric critical care settings.
items.limitation: 研究为回顾性队列设计，存在选择偏倚，且样本量相对有限。
items.limitationEn: The study's retrospective cohort design is subject to selection bias, and the sample size is relatively limited.

items.title: Unlocking the potential of light-intensity physical activity for public health: a call to action for research
items.summary: This call to action highlights the overlooked potential of light-intensity physical activity (LPA) for public health and urges more research to inform future guidelines, as most adults engage predominantly in LPA.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评呼吁加大对低强度身体活动（LPA）的研究，以更好地将其纳入公共卫生指南，填补现有指南主要关注中高强度活动的空白。对你理解未来身体活动指南的潜在方向有帮助。
items.titleZh: 挖掘低强度身体活动在公共卫生中的潜力：研究的行动呼吁
items.summaryZh: 这篇行动呼吁强调了低强度身体活动（LPA）在公共卫生领域被忽视的潜力，并敦促进行更多研究以指导未来的指南，因为大多数成年人主要进行LPA。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary calls for more research into light-intensity physical activity (LPA) to better integrate it into public health guidelines, addressing the current gap where guidelines primarily focus on moderate-to-vigorous activity. This informs your understanding of potential future directions in physical activity recommendations.

items.title: Evaluating movement breaks as a public health strategy to mitigate the harms of prolonged sitting: a large-scale pragmatic intervention
items.summary: A pragmatic intervention with 19,342 adults showed that 5-minute walking breaks, self-selected to occur every 30, 60, or 120 minutes, were feasible and improved psychosocial outcomes (fatigue, positive/negative affect) when embedded in an interactive podcast.
items.curatedReason: 这项大规模研究提示，短时运动间歇作为公共卫生策略，在真实世界中是可行且能改善心理社会结果的，支持你向患者推广规律的短暂活动间歇，以对抗长时间久坐的危害。
items.titleZh: 评估运动间歇作为减轻长时间久坐危害的公共卫生策略：一项大规模实用干预研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对19,342名成年人的实用干预研究显示，将每30、60或120分钟的5分钟步行间歇嵌入互动播客中是可行的，并能改善心理社会结果（疲劳、积极/消极情绪）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large-scale study suggests that short movement breaks as a public health strategy are feasible and improve psychosocial outcomes in real-world settings, supporting your recommendation of regular brief activity breaks to patients to counteract the harms of prolonged sitting.
items.limitation: 研究未评估运动间歇对生理健康指标（如心血管代谢）的长期影响。
items.limitationEn: The study did not assess the long-term impact of movement breaks on physiological health outcomes, such as cardiometabolic health.

items.title: Resting and exercise-induced occult hypertension and coronary atherosclerosis in male masters endurance athletes
items.summary: In 198 male master endurance athletes with low Framingham risk, 39% had occult hypertension on 24-hour ambulatory BP monitoring and 47% had exercise-induced hypertension, both linked to coronary atherosclerosis characteristics.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，即便低Framingham风险评分、无临床高血压诊断的男性精英耐力运动员中，仍有高比例存在隐匿性高血压和运动诱发高血压，且与冠状动脉粥样硬化相关。这提示你在评估耐力运动员心血管风险时，需要更全面的血压监测。
items.titleZh: 男性精英耐力运动员静息和运动诱发隐匿性高血压与冠状动脉粥样硬化
items.summaryZh: 在198名低Framingham风险的男性精英耐力运动员中，39%在24小时动态血压监测中存在隐匿性高血压，47%存在运动诱发高血压，两者均与冠状动脉粥样硬化特征相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found a high prevalence of occult and exercise-induced hypertension in male master endurance athletes with low Framingham risk scores and no clinical hypertension diagnosis, which was associated with coronary atherosclerosis. This suggests the need for more comprehensive blood pressure monitoring when assessing cardiovascular risk in endurance athletes.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，无法推断因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The study had a cross-sectional design, preventing causal inference.

items.title: Dual-pillar phenotype of elite deaf female soccer players: reduced aerobic capacity and repeated-sprint ability coexisting with enhanced explosive power
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 18 elite deaf and 21 hearing female soccer players found that deaf athletes had lower maximal oxygen uptake (VO2max) and poorer repeated-sprint ability, but enhanced countermovement jump (CMJ) explosive power, suggesting a dual-pillar phenotype.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究揭示了精英聋人女足球运动员在心肺和重复冲刺能力方面可能存在劣势，但在爆发力方面有所增强。这提示你在制定聋人运动员训练计划时，需考虑这些潜在的生理适应差异，并进行个性化调整。
items.titleZh: 精英聋人女足球运动员的双重表型：有氧能力和重复冲刺能力下降，但爆发力增强
items.summaryZh: 一项对18名精英聋人女足球运动员和21名听力女足球运动员的横断面研究发现，聋人运动员的最大摄氧量（VO2max）和重复冲刺能力较低，但反向跳跃（CMJ）爆发力增强，这提示存在一种双重表型。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals that elite deaf female soccer players may have deficits in cardiorespiratory and repeated-sprint ability, but enhanced explosive power. This suggests that when designing training programs for deaf athletes, you should consider these potential physiological adaptation differences and make individualized adjustments.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且仅限于女性足球运动员，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size and exclusive focus on female soccer players limit the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Infographic. Active commuting is linked to lower coronary atherosclerosis
items.summary: An infographic summarizes findings from a population-based study demonstrating a link between active commuting (walking or cycling to work) and lower coronary atherosclerosis, supporting physical activity for cardiovascular disease prevention.
items.curatedReason: 这张信息图总结的研究表明，积极通勤（步行或骑自行车上班）与较低的冠状动脉粥样硬化风险相关。这为你在患者健康教育中推广此类日常物理活动提供了直观证据。
items.titleZh: 信息图：积极通勤与较低的冠状动脉粥样硬化相关
items.summaryZh: 一张信息图总结了一项基于人群的研究结果，该研究表明积极通勤（步行或骑自行车上班）与较低的冠状动脉粥样硬化相关，支持将体育活动用于心血管疾病预防。
items.curatedReasonEn: This infographic summarizes research showing that active commuting (walking or cycling to work) is linked to lower coronary atherosclerosis risk. This provides visual evidence for you to promote such routine physical activities in patient health education.
items.limitation: 信息图基于一项人口队列研究，无法直接推断因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The infographic is based on a population cohort study, limiting direct causal inference.

items.title: Role of exercise in improving bone health in young paediatric patients with a history of cancer (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD Academy Award entry focused on assessing the impact of resistance exercise with high-impact loading and movement behaviors on bone health in young pediatric patients with a history of cancer.
items.curatedReason: 这项博士研究指出，对于有癌症病史的儿童患者，高强度抗阻训练和高冲击负荷运动行为对其骨骼健康有潜在影响。在为这些患儿制定康复计划时，务必考虑并纳入能促进骨骼健康的运动干预。
items.titleZh: 运动在改善有癌症病史的年轻儿童患者骨骼健康中的作用（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 这项博士学院奖研究着重评估了高强度抗阻训练和运动行为对有癌症病史的年轻儿童患者骨骼健康的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD study highlights the potential impact of high-impact resistance exercise and movement behaviors on bone health in pediatric cancer survivors. When developing rehabilitation plans for these patients, you must consider and incorporate exercise interventions that promote bone health.
items.limitation: 该研究为博士课题综述，缺乏具体方法学和结果细节。
items.limitationEn: This is a PhD thesis overview, lacking specific methodological and results details.

items.title: High-intensity circuit training combined with sleep or dietary interventions improves cardiometabolic health, sleep health and executive function (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD Academy Award thesis investigated the effects of high-intensity circuit training (HICT), alone or combined with sleep or dietary interventions, on cardiometabolic health, sleep health, and executive function in women.
items.curatedReason: 这项博士研究探索了高强度循环训练（HICT）结合睡眠或饮食干预对女性心血管代谢健康、睡眠和执行功能的影响。这提示你在提供生活方式干预时，可以考虑多模态的HICT方案，以优化综合健康结局。
items.titleZh: 高强度循环训练结合睡眠或饮食干预改善心血管代谢健康、睡眠健康和执行功能（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 这项博士学院奖论文研究了高强度循环训练（HICT）单独或结合睡眠或饮食干预对女性心血管代谢健康、睡眠健康和执行功能的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD research explored the effects of high-intensity circuit training (HICT) combined with sleep or dietary interventions on cardiometabolic health, sleep health, and executive function in women. This suggests you can consider multimodal HICT programs when delivering lifestyle interventions to optimize comprehensive health outcomes.
items.limitation: 该研究为博士课题综述，缺乏具体方法学和结果细节。
items.limitationEn: This is a PhD thesis overview, lacking specific methodological and results details.

items.title: Prospective Physical Activity, Sitting and Sleep consortium (ProPASS): addressing methodological and geographical barriers to inform global public health guidelines, interventions and precision medicine
items.summary: The Prospective Physical Activity, Sitting and Sleep consortium (ProPASS) aims to address methodological and geographical barriers in informing global public health guidelines by using device-measured data instead of self-report methods for physical activity, sedentary behavior, and sleep.
items.curatedReason: 这项联盟计划旨在通过改进身体活动、久坐行为和睡眠的测量方法，克服传统自我报告数据的局限性，这将有助于未来制定更精准的公共卫生指南和干预措施。
items.titleZh: ProPASS 联盟：克服方法学和地理障碍以指导全球公共卫生指南、干预和精准医疗
items.summaryZh: ProPASS 联盟旨在通过采用设备测量数据而非自我报告方法来描述身体活动、久坐行为和睡眠，从而克服方法学和地理障碍，为全球公共卫生指南提供信息。
items.curatedReasonEn: This consortium aims to overcome the limitations of traditional self-reported data by improving the measurement of physical activity, sedentary behavior, and sleep, which will aid in developing more precise public health guidelines and interventions in the future.

items.title: Exploring the effects of exogenous ketosis on physiological adaptation to exercise in hypoxia(PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD Academy Award entry investigated the potential of exogenous ketosis (EK) to mitigate adverse effects of hypoxia and augment beneficial hypoxic adaptation during exercise, exploring underlying physiological and muscular mechanisms.
items.curatedReason: 关于外源性酮症能否减轻缺氧不利影响并增强运动时有益的缺氧适应，这项博士研究做了机制探索。目前仍是理论阶段，不建议将此作为临床干预手段，但它为我们理解运动生理学提供了新视角。
items.titleZh: 探索外源性酮症对低氧环境下运动生理适应的影响（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 这项博士学院奖研究探讨了外源性酮症（EK）在低氧环境下减轻运动不良影响和增强有利低氧适应的潜力，并深入研究了其潜在的生理和肌肉机制。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD research explored the potential effects of exogenous ketosis on physiological adaptation to exercise in hypoxic, high-altitude environments. While specific clinical applications remain unclear, it expands your understanding of exercise physiology and nutritional interventions.
items.limitation: 该研究为博士课题综述，缺乏具体方法学和结果细节。
items.limitationEn: This is a PhD thesis overview, lacking specific methodological and results details.

items.title: Beyond the Diagnosis: An Integrated Perspective on Strategic Dosing in Neurologic Motor Rehabilitation. A Scoping Review and Collaborative Viewpoint.
items.summary: This scoping review and collaborative viewpoint propose an integrated, mechanism-based framework for strategic dosing in neurologic motor rehabilitation, suggesting higher intensity for non-progressive conditions and conservative strategies for progressive conditions, to address suboptimal long-term outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这份综述和专家观点提出，神经运动康复应采取基于机制的“策略性剂量”框架，而非传统的诊断驱动模式。对于非进展性疾病，你可能需要提高干预强度；而对于进展性疾病，则应采取更保守的策略，以期改善长期疗效。
items.titleZh: 超越诊断：神经运动康复中策略性剂量的综合视角。一项范围综述与合作观点
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述和合作观点提出了神经运动康复中策略性剂量的综合性、基于机制的框架，建议对非进展性疾病采用高强度方法，对进展性疾病采用更保守、节约能量的策略，以应对长期疗效不佳的问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review and expert viewpoint advocate for a mechanism-based 'strategic dosing' framework in neurologic motor rehabilitation, moving beyond traditional diagnosis-driven approaches. For non-progressive conditions, you might need to increase intervention intensity; for progressive conditions, a more conservative strategy should be adopted to improve long-term outcomes.
items.limitation: 文献缺乏标准化剂量参数的共识，且综述未能提供具体剂量方案，主要集中于概念框架。
items.limitationEn: The literature lacks consensus on standardized dosing parameters, and the review does not provide specific dosing protocols, focusing primarily on conceptual frameworks.

items.title: A systematic review of early neuroimaging and neurophysiological biomarkers for post-stroke mobility prognostication.
items.summary: This systematic review examined the prognostic capacity of early neuroimaging and neurophysiological biomarkers for mobility outcomes up to 24 months post-stroke, to help guide rehabilitation planning.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述确认了早期神经影像学和神经生理学生物标志物在中风后24个月内对运动预后的预测价值。这意味着我们应将这些早期指标纳入评估，以更精准地识别高风险患者并优化其康复路径。
items.titleZh: 中风后运动预后早期神经影像和神经生理学生物标志物的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述旨在评估中风后14天内测量的早期神经影像学和神经生理学生物标志物，对24个月内运动结局的预测能力，以指导康复计划和目标设定。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review confirms the prognostic value of early neuroimaging and neurophysiological biomarkers for mobility outcomes up to 24 months post-stroke. We should integrate these early indicators into our assessments to more accurately identify high-risk patients and optimize their rehabilitation pathways.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学存在偏倚风险，且生物标志物分析方法多样，限制了结果的综合性。
items.limitationEn: The included studies had a risk of methodological bias, and the diverse biomarker analysis approaches limited the generalizability of results.

items.title: Survey on stroke rehabilitation in Europe (SUSTAIN-EU) to evaluate European stroke rehabilitation services.
items.summary: The SUSTAIN-EU survey assessed the organization and delivery of post-stroke rehabilitation services across 30 European countries, revealing commonalities and disparities in service provision with an 81% response rate.
items.curatedReason: 这项覆盖30个欧洲国家的调查揭示了中风康复服务在组织和提供上的显著差异与共性。尽管不能直接指导临床操作，但你可以此为镜，审视和思考你所在地区康复服务的优化空间，尤其是在服务公平性和效率方面。
items.titleZh: 欧洲中风康复调查（SUSTAIN-EU）评估欧洲中风康复服务
items.summaryZh: SUSTAIN-EU 调查评估了30个欧洲国家中风后康复服务的组织和提供情况，以81%的回复率揭示了服务提供上的共通之处和差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This survey across 30 European countries highlights significant commonalities and disparities in the organization and delivery of stroke rehabilitation services. While not directly guiding clinical practice, you can use this as a benchmark to assess and consider optimization opportunities for rehabilitation services in your region, particularly regarding equity and efficiency.
items.limitation: 这是一项描述性横断面调查研究，无法评估干预措施的因果关系或服务质量。
items.limitationEn: This is a descriptive cross-sectional survey study and cannot assess causal relationships of interventions or service quality.

items.title: Characteristics of Classified Gait Pattern Subgroups and Definitions of Abnormal Gait Patterns Following Stroke: A Scoping Review.
items.summary: This scoping review explored existing characteristics of classified gait pattern subgroups and definitions of abnormal gait patterns following stroke, finding a lack of standardized definitions despite the importance of individualized gait training.
items.curatedReason: 中风后步态模式的分类和异常步态的定义至今仍缺乏标准化，这意味着我们目前在进行个体化步态训练时，所依赖的分类框架可能存在局限。在临床实践中，应警惕现有分类的普适性问题，这提示我们需要更精细的评估工具。
items.titleZh: 中风后分类步态模式亚组特征及异常步态模式定义：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述探讨了中风后步态模式亚组的分类特征和异常步态模式的定义，发现尽管个体化步态训练日益重要，但标准化定义仍然缺乏。
items.curatedReasonEn: Standardized definitions for post-stroke gait patterns and abnormal gait are still missing, indicating limitations in current classification frameworks for individualized gait training. In practice, be aware of the generalizability issues with existing classifications; this highlights the need for more refined assessment tools.
items.limitation: 这是一项范围综述，并未对文献进行质量评估，且研究缺乏标准化定义和分类。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review that did not assess literature quality, and studies lacked standardized definitions and classifications.

items.title: Effectiveness of a Personalized Robot-Assisted Trunk and Lower Limb Rehabilitation in Patients with Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=40) found that adding personalized robot-assisted trunk and lower limb training to conventional rehabilitation significantly improved Functional Ambulatory Category (FAC) scores in patients with chronic stroke over 3 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证实，在常规康复基础上增加个性化机器人辅助躯干和下肢训练，能显著改善慢性卒中患者的步行功能。这意味着你可以考虑将这类机器人辅助疗法整合到慢性卒中患者的康复方案中，尤其是对于改善独立步行能力。
items.titleZh: 个性化机器人辅助躯干和下肢康复对慢性卒中患者的疗效：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=40）发现，在常规康复基础上增加个性化机器人辅助躯干和下肢训练，可在 3 个月内显著改善慢性卒中患者的功能性步行分类 (FAC) 评分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms that adding personalized robot-assisted trunk and lower limb training to conventional rehabilitation significantly improves walking function in chronic stroke patients. This implies you can consider integrating such robot-assisted therapy into chronic stroke rehabilitation protocols, especially for enhancing independent ambulation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（n=40），且随访期仅为 3 个月，长期效果和更大样本的普适性尚需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=40) and a follow-up period of only 3 months; long-term effects and generalizability to larger populations require further validation.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Responsiveness, Smallest Detectable Change, and Minimal Important Change of the Turkish Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory-20 Following Pelvic Floor Muscle Training.
items.summary: A multicenter retrospective study of 200 women with pelvic floor dysfunction found the Turkish Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory-20 (PFDI-20) to be responsive to pelvic floor muscle training, establishing its smallest detectable change (SDC) and minimal important change (MIC).
items.curatedReason: 本研究确立了土耳其语版 PFDI-20 量表在盆底肌肉训练后，响应性良好且最小可检测变化 (SDC) 和最小重要变化 (MIC) 的具体值。这有助于你更精准地评估土耳其裔盆底功能障碍患者的治疗效果，判断临床有意义的改善。
items.titleZh: 土耳其语版盆底功能障碍问卷-20 (PFDI-20) 在盆底肌肉训练后的响应性、最小可检测变化和最小重要变化
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 200 名盆底功能障碍女性的多中心回顾性研究显示，土耳其语版 PFDI-20 量表在盆底肌肉训练后响应性良好，并确立了其最小可检测变化 (SDC) 和最小重要变化 (MIC)。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study establishes the responsiveness, SDC, and MIC for the Turkish PFDI-20 after pelvic floor muscle training. This helps you more precisely evaluate treatment efficacy and identify clinically meaningful improvements in Turkish-speaking patients with pelvic floor dysfunction.
items.limitation: 本回顾性研究是在土耳其人群中进行的，其 SDC 和 MIC 值可能不完全适用于其他文化或语言背景的患者。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective study was conducted in a Turkish population, and its SDC and MIC values may not be fully applicable to patients from other cultural or linguistic backgrounds.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Relief increases select shoulder muscle activity, following subacromial injection in subacromial pain syndrome.
items.summary: This study investigated the effects of immediate and long-term pain reduction on shoulder muscle activation in 21 individuals with subacromial pain syndrome, finding that a subacromial injection led to increased select shoulder muscle activity.
items.curatedReason: 局部麻醉性注射能够即时改善肩峰下疼痛综合征患者的肩部肌肉激活，即使在物理治疗后，这种改善也能维持。评估患者对短期镇痛的反应，可能帮你筛选出对后续康复训练反应更好的患者。
items.titleZh: 肩峰下注射减轻疼痛后，肩峰下疼痛综合征患者选择性肩部肌肉活动增加
items.summaryZh: 这项研究调查了 21 名肩峰下疼痛综合征患者在疼痛减轻后肩部肌肉激活的变化，发现肩峰下注射可即时增加部分肩部肌肉的活动。
items.curatedReasonEn: Local anesthetic injections might immediately improve shoulder muscle activation in patients with subacromial pain syndrome, with benefits potentially sustained post-physical therapy. Consider using a patient’s response to short-term analgesia as a screening tool; it could help predict those who will respond better to subsequent rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且无法完全排除肌电信号变异性对结果的影响。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size, and could not completely exclude the impact of EMG signal variability on the results.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Ethics and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Stroke Rehabilitation.
items.summary: This commentary explores the ethical considerations surrounding the increasing integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into stroke rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 随着人工智能在卒中康复中的应用日益增多，理解其伦理考量变得至关重要。这篇述评能帮你预判潜在的公平性、隐私和责任问题，以便在临床实践中更负责任地部署 AI 技术。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复中的伦理与人工智能
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评探讨了人工智能在卒中康复中日益增长的应用所涉及的伦理考量。
items.curatedReasonEn: As AI increasingly integrates into stroke rehabilitation, understanding its ethical considerations is crucial. This commentary helps you anticipate potential issues of fairness, privacy, and accountability for more responsible AI deployment in clinical practice.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Mental health in elite athletes: International Olympic Committee consensus statement (2026)
items.summary: The updated International Olympic Committee consensus statement (2026) emphasizes that mental health symptoms and disorders are common in elite athletes, may be sport-related, and impact performance, recommending routine screening and monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 这份 IOC 共识声明强调精英运动员心理健康问题普遍且可能与运动相关，并推荐使用验证工具进行常规筛查和监测。它确认了心理健康在运动康复中的重要性，你在日常实践中应更关注运动员的心理状态并考虑恰当的转诊。
items.titleZh: 精英运动员心理健康：国际奥委会共识声明（2026）
