items.summaryZh: 更新后的国际奥委会共识声明（2026）强调，精英运动员的心理健康症状和障碍普遍存在，可能与运动相关并影响表现，建议进行常规筛查和监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: This IOC consensus statement highlights the prevalence of mental health issues in elite athletes, their potential sport-related etiologies, and recommends routine screening and monitoring. It affirms the importance of mental health in sports rehabilitation, prompting you to pay closer attention to athletes' psychological states and consider appropriate referrals.

items.title: Understanding the family planning experiences and information needs of people living with multiple sclerosis: an Australian cohort study.
items.summary: An Australian cross-sectional study of 270 people with multiple sclerosis (MS) found that 44.0% reported MS impacted their reproductive planning decisions, and 14.7% decided against having children due to MS.
items.curatedReason: 本研究揭示了多发性硬化症（MS）对澳大利亚患者生育计划的显著影响，其中近一半患者表示MS影响了生育决定。这提示你在与MS患者讨论康复计划时，需要主动纳入生育考量。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚队列研究：理解多发性硬化症患者的生育计划经历和信息需求
items.summaryZh: 一项对270名澳大利亚多发性硬化症患者进行的横断面研究发现，44.0%的受访者表示MS影响了他们的生育规划决定，14.7%的受访者因MS决定不生育。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights the significant impact of MS on family planning decisions among Australian patients, with nearly half reporting an influence on reproductive choices. When discussing rehabilitation plans with MS patients, proactively incorporate family planning considerations.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: The study's cross-sectional design prevents establishing causality and may be subject to recall bias.

items.title: Physical and mental health-related quality of life outcomes of non-pharmacological interventions in early multiple sclerosis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found non-pharmacological interventions to improve physical and mental health-related quality of life in adults with early-stage multiple sclerosis and minimal disability.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述和荟萃分析强调了早期多发性硬化症非药物干预对改善身体和精神健康相关生活质量的重要性。将其纳入你的临床实践考量，尤其是在疾病早期阶段。
items.titleZh: 早期多发性硬化症非药物干预对身心健康相关生活质量结局的影响：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述与荟萃分析发现，非药物干预能改善早期多发性硬化症且残疾程度轻微的成年患者的身心健康相关生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis highlights the importance of non-pharmacological interventions in improving physical and mental health-related quality of life in early multiple sclerosis. Integrate these findings into your clinical practice, especially for patients in early disease stages.
items.limitation: 研究只纳入了早期多发性硬化症且残疾程度轻微的患者，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study only included patients with early multiple sclerosis and minimal disability, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Exercise Interventions for Older Adults with Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis investigated the effectiveness and optimal dosage of physical exercise on cognitive function in older adults with Alzheimer's disease.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述肯定了运动干预对阿尔茨海默病老年患者认知功能的益处。在设计康复方案时，应将运动作为核心要素，并关注最佳剂量以最大化疗效。
items.titleZh: 运动干预对阿尔茨海默病老年患者的影响：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述与荟萃分析探讨了运动干预对阿尔茨海默病老年患者认知功能的有效性及其最佳剂量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review confirms the benefits of exercise interventions for cognitive function in older adults with Alzheimer's disease. Incorporate exercise as a core component in rehabilitation programs, and consider optimal dosages to maximize effectiveness.
items.limitation: 综述未明确指出不同运动类型或强度的具体效果差异，也未给出明确的“最佳剂量”数据。
items.limitationEn: The review did not explicitly detail the differential effects of various exercise types or intensities, nor did it provide specific “optimal dosage” data.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Clinically interpretable prediction models of stroke functional outcomes: A national cohort study of adults in inpatient rehabilitation facilities in the US.
items.summary: A national retrospective cohort study (n=43,745) of US stroke patients in inpatient rehabilitation facilities developed clinically interpretable machine learning models to predict self-care and mobility function at discharge using IRF-PAI variables.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究基于美国大规模真实世界数据，构建了可靠的卒中康复出院功能预测模型。它能帮你预估患者自理和活动功能，辅助制定更切合实际的康复目标和出院计划。
items.titleZh: 美国住院康复机构卒中患者功能结局的临床可解释预测模型：一项全国队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对美国住院康复机构43,745名卒中患者进行的全国回顾性队列研究，利用IRF-PAI变量构建了临床可解释的机器学习模型，以预测出院时的自理和活动功能。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study, based on large-scale US real-world data, developed reliable prediction models for stroke rehabilitation functional outcomes at discharge. It can help you estimate patient self-care and mobility functions, aiding in setting more realistic rehabilitation goals and discharge plans.
items.limitation: 作为回顾性队列研究，尽管样本量大，但可能存在未测量混杂因素的风险，且模型基于IRF-PAI变量，可能无法捕捉所有临床复杂性。
items.limitationEn: As a retrospective cohort study, despite its large sample size, there's a risk of unmeasured confounders, and the model, based on IRF-PAI variables, may not capture all clinical complexities.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effect of kinesiology taping on limb oedema in patients with severe hyper-dependency using shear-wave elastography: a randomized clinical trial.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial (n=50) demonstrated that kinesiology taping at 25% tension significantly reduced the dermal elastic coefficient and limb circumference in patients with severe hyper-dependency limb oedema compared to 0% tension taping by day 9.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT研究表明，25%张力的肌内效贴能显著减少严重肢体水肿患者的真皮弹性系数，提示其在改善水肿方面有一定潜力。考虑将其作为辅助手段，尤其是当你希望减少组织硬度时。
items.titleZh: 肌内效贴在严重高依赖性肢体水肿患者中对肢体水肿的影响：一项随机临床试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机临床试验（n=50）表明，与0%张力贴扎相比，25%张力的肌内效贴能显著降低严重高依赖性肢体水肿患者的真皮弹性系数和肢体周长，效应在第9天显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that kinesiology taping at 25% tension significantly reduces dermal elastic coefficient in patients with severe limb edema, indicating its potential in edema reduction. Consider it as an adjunct, especially when aiming to reduce tissue stiffness.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是弹力系数和肢体周长，但并未评估患者功能或疼痛等更全面的临床结局，且随访时间较短。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on elastic coefficient and limb circumference but did not assess broader clinical outcomes such like patient function or pain, and the follow-up period was relatively short.

items.title: Reliability and construct validity of three movement-evoked pain methods in individuals with knee osteoarthritis.
items.summary: This study evaluated the reliability and construct validity of three movement-evoked pain calculation methods using performance-based tests in 111 individuals with knee osteoarthritis, finding varying levels of reliability and validity.
items.curatedReason: 对于膝骨关节炎（KOA）患者，运动诱发疼痛的测量方法并非都一样可靠。你需要留意，本研究评估的三种计算方法，其信度和效度各有不同，这提示我们在选择评估工具时，务必结合具体临床情境，避免盲目采纳。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者三种运动诱发疼痛测量方法的信度与结构效度
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了111名膝骨关节炎患者，在基于表现的测试中，三种运动诱发疼痛计算方法的信度和结构效度，发现其可靠性和有效性存在差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Not all methods for measuring movement-evoked pain in KOA are equally reliable. This study, evaluating three calculation methods, shows varying levels of reliability and validity, suggesting you must be judicious in selecting assessment tools based on your specific clinical context.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且为单一中心观察性研究的二次分析，可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size and secondary analysis from a single-center observational study may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation
